source.notes: arch-048. Two-stage slot-summary combinator: stage 1 hk_t = hk_{t-1}·exp(g_t)[None,:] + k_t⊗s_t (slot decay on the COLUMN axis), ok_t = (scale·q_t)ᵀhk_t, qv_t = softmax(ok_t) (external interstage); stage 2 hv_t = hv_{t-1}·exp(g_t)[:,None] + s_t⊗v_t (slot decay on the ROW axis), o_t = qv_tᵀhv_t. g derived from slot logits (z = logcumsumexp(s), g_t = z_{t-1} − z_t, s = exp(s−z)) — external. Verified against fla/ops/abc/naive.py @ 864a87f6. Layer module: architectures/abc_gsa.py.

params.combinator: two additive per-slot-decayed accumulators + external interstage slot softmax
external_stages: stage-1 slot summary (column-axis slot decay, external recurrence)
stage-2 value summary (typed K2 channel-gate, row-axis slot decay)
params.structural_finding: the K2 channel gate decays the KEY axis; it covers stage 2 (slot = key) but NOT stage 1 (slot = value axis) — stage 1 is external. The sweep's 'two U2.A calls' is imprecise on the stage-1 gate axis.

coverage.notes: Parity vs the pinned naive_recurrent_abc (fp32) in tests/test_architectures_abc_gsa.py; gradients through both stages. The chunked kernel (chunk.py) reproduction of the two-pass coupling and initial_state handling for both hk and hv are residual external work, not claimed.
